whatIs: Magic Loops is a no-code platform for creating apps with AI and turning repetitive tasks into automations. It also has a catalog of community-built apps that you can open and use.
It's a good fit for automating small tasks, such as summarizing links or processing data, without setting up your own service.
uses: Creating a loop that summarizes links or articles.
Turning a repetitive task, such as sorting expenses or summarizing texts, into an automation.
Publishing a mini app so others can use it from a link.
caveats: Everything runs on generation and execution credits; heavily used apps can exhaust the quota.
On the free plan, loops are public; private ones require a paid plan.
Your loops live on the platform, so you depend on it to run them.
pricingNote: Free plan with 250 generation credits a day and 500 execution credits a month; paid plans start at $9 a month.
idealFor: Automations and mini apps with AI without setting up infrastructure.
